items.title: Arsenal hold off energetic Sunderland to continue perfect title defence
items.excerpt: Arsenal maintain their 100% start to their Premier League season with a win at Sunderland, who mount an admirable push for a point before Bukayo Saka's penalty puts the result beyond doubt.

items.title: Hull remain unbeaten in league after impressive Chelsea draw
items.excerpt: In-form striker Joao Pedro scores a second-half equaliser as Chelsea rescues a point at home to promoted Hull City.

items.title: Flemming's late strike earns Ipswich win over 10-man Crystal Palace
items.excerpt: Zian Flemming scores his first goal for Ipswich to give the club a late victory over 10-man Crystal Palace at Selhurst Park.

items.title: Brentford hold Bournemouth as Rose's wait for a win continues
items.excerpt: Marco Rose's wait for a first Premier League victory as Bournemouth head coach continues as they are held to a 2-2 draw by Brentford at Vitality Stadium.

items.title: Tottenham's wait for league goal continues after Everton draw
items.excerpt: Tottenham's wait for a first Premier League goal and win this season continues after Roberto de Zerbi's side were held to a goalless home draw by Everton.

items.title: 'Today the game was unprotected' - Arteta fumes but Arsenal survive
items.excerpt: Arsenal produced a gritty 2-0 win against Sunderland, but Mikel Arteta fumed about the penalty that could have cost his side a result.
